auditMethod.rule: Treat completion as unproven until each original requirement has current evidence.
auditMethod.scope: This audit covers the current command-center implementation, including static artifacts, the read-only live readiness route, the read-only canonical store readiness route, the read-only Codex harness route, the read-only command record schema route, the read-only communication protocols route, the read-only MCP/tooling map route, the read-only browser task tooling route, the read-only tooling recommendation plan route, the read-only memory intake funnel route, the read-only VANTA-Brain coverage route, the read-only daily command workflow route, the read-only execution sequence route, the read-only approval packet route, the read-only delivery roadmap route, the read-only live app map route, the read-only live GTM map route, the read-only live team data routing route, the read-only live command gates route, the read-only live implementation proof route, the read-only live AzA verification runbook route, the read-only live brain topology route, the read-only live agent access matrix route, the read-only live agent fleet map route, the read-only live content operations route, the read-only live content app audit route, the read-only live access capability route, the read-only live ownership resolution route, the read-only live project map route, the read-only live workspace root reconciliation route, the read-only live memory map route, the read-only live service map route, the derived operating board route, the read-only live operating records route, the read-only system map route, and the live goal completion audit route. It does not claim that dynamic AzA API/MCP memory adapters are complete.

liveBlockers.blocker: AzA durable GTM/content/projection adapters are partial
liveBlockers.evidence: Live readiness sees healthy listeners on 8786 gateway, 8787 API, 8788 MCP, 8789 sync, and 8790 worker; API /ready now reports mode=postgres against the local proof database. Durable project/task, Codex handoff, evidence, and operating record writes are proven.
liveBlockers.impact: Durable board, handoff, evidence, and offer/lead/pilot/task/content/publish/measurement records exist, but approval decisions, native LobeHub task creation, browser-session adapters, app account/output metadata, and VANTA-Brain projection still need adapters.

liveBlockers.blocker: Durable store runtime depends on local Postgres proof process
liveBlockers.evidence: The current durable proof uses Postgres 16 on 127.0.0.1:55432 with pgvector installed from source and DATABASE_URL supplied to the AzA dev stack.
liveBlockers.impact: The proof is live and valid for this session, but it should be converted into a repeatable startup script or Docker path before being treated as permanent infrastructure.

liveBlockers.evidence: Sync provider fetch is not configured; worker queue list is broad but only extract.knowledge processor was observed.
liveBlockers.impact: Native conversation sync, memory proposal flow, embeddings, search indexing, and projection are not complete.

liveBlockers.evidence: User explicitly prohibited writes to VANTA-Brain during this pass.
liveBlockers.impact: Projection can be designed but not executed.

liveBlockers.evidence: The live VANTA-Brain coverage route reports root present but projectionScanTimedOut=true and projectionScanBlocked=true.
liveBlockers.impact: The vault cannot be treated as reliable command-center context until directory enumeration is repaired or the projection path is relocated.

nextProofGates.proofNeeded: Keep /aza/live-readiness green: GET /health succeeds for gateway, API, MCP, sync, and worker on 127.0.0.1 ports 8786-8790, while /ready mode is tracked separately.
Migrations run, pgvector exists, expected tables exist, API and MCP both use the same durable Postgres store.

MCP initialize succeeds, tool list is visible, all six implemented retrieval tools return structured responses to safe probes, placeholders are marked unavailable, and API/MCP shared-store proof exists.
LobeHub reads live AzA operating records, board records, and app registry records after service health, schema, durable store, and MCP gates are verified.
Daily Command, GTM, or Content Factory board reads durable typed AzA records and shows owner, status, evidence, and next action.
User approves a specific VANTA-Brain projection target after canonical AzA write and redaction verification.
